name: MXNB
oneLiner: MXNB is backed by segregated MXN cash, cash equivalents, and short-term Mexican government securities and issued under El Salvador's CNAD.
collateral: Mexican peso cash, cash-equivalent assets, and short-term Mexican government securities held through segregated custodial accounts; beginning April 8, 2026, MXNB is issued by Nvio Pagos El Salvador, S.A. de C.V., an authorised digital-asset issuer in El Salvador
pegMechanism: 1:1 MXN fiat-collateralized stablecoin; Juno/MXNB materials describe reserve parity, token burn/redemption through issuer rails, and quarterly third-party attestations confirming reserves exceed circulating supply

sources.label: BDO Mexico MXNB Q1 2026 valuation report

reserveReview.rationale: MXNB's current transparency page reports 37.7 million MXN of reserves against 37.2 million MXNB in circulation as of July 12, 2026. The issuer's whitepaper says the reserve spans pesos, cash equivalents, and an internally audited short-term Mexican-government-security process, but publishes no current category or provider weights. The March 31 BDO report confirms Nvio and Hey Banco statement balances for that earlier date without narrowing the issuer's complete permitted reserve envelope.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current issuer balance disclosure plus the whitepaper's complete reserve-policy envelope
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current weights across cash, cash equivalents, short-term government securities, accounts, and providers are not published.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The whitepaper states that reserves are legally and operationally segregated from issuer and affiliate operating funds and held through a single-purpose entity. It does not establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness, current provider shares, account-level allocations, or rehypothecation treatment.

mintAuthority.summary: MXNB is a FiatToken-fork proxy. On Ethereum and Arbitrum, masterMinter() = owner() = EOA 0xcf3783abaf4a11da1382f0c49748fa87a1b6b739. Proxy admin is also EOA 0x4d64a2ccfed1a162c8b1d7a3d8fffeccab3305ca. All three are issuer-controlled EOAs with no multisig.

controls.label: MXNB masterMinter / owner (Ethereum, Arbitrum — EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295171, masterMinter() = 0xcf3783abaf4a11da1382f0c49748fa87a1b6b739; owner() = same address. eth_getCode = 0x (EOA confirmed on both Ethereum and Arbitrum). At Arbitrum block 472412264, masterMinter() and owner() also return 0xcf3783abaf4a11da1382f0c49748fa87a1b6b739.

controls.label: MXNB proxy admin (Ethereum and Arbitrum — EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295171, custom proxy admin slot (0x10d6a5...) = 0x4d64a2ccfed1a162c8b1d7a3d8fffeccab3305ca; eth_getCode = 0x (EOA confirmed). Same address in Arbitrum block 472412264 proxy admin slot.

review.evidence: MXNB on Ethereum and Arbitrum is an upgradeable FiatToken-fork proxy. masterMinter() and owner() both resolve to EOA 0xcf3783...b739 on both chains. The proxy admin slot also resolves to an EOA 0x4d64a2...05ca. All confirmed via eth_call and eth_getCode at blocks 25295171 (ETH) and 472412264 (ARB). The same contract address 0xf197ffc... is used on all five listed chains.
